top_choice_rationale: P001 (targeted protein degradation: Crews, Deshaies, Handa) is a new chemical modality whose mechanism is understood at the molecular level: a designed small molecule brings a ubiquitin ligase and a chosen protein together, confirmed independently through ternary-complex structures and degradation kinetics. Handa's identification of cereblon explains how the approved glue drugs lenalidomide and pomalidomide work, so the induced-proximity logic is clinically validated, and one citation about redirecting the ubiquitin-proteasome system can honestly cover both strands. The omission of Ciulli, Sakamoto, Gray, Ito and Kim is a real attribution cost and no bifunctional degrader is yet approved, but P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig, C-N coupling) is mature and cleanly attributed yet extends the cross-coupling field honoured in 2010, so I rank it second, above no award.
